notes.title: Three new outfits for your daughter

items.text: \[Love Unknown] Triggers automatically when you enter the Daughter's Room in Month 2 of volcano winter
\[Goddess Outfit] Obtained by entering the Daughter's Room during volcano summer after completing your first playthrough
\[St. Elmore's Academy Uniform] Obtained automatically after the enrollment event in Month 1 of volcano summer
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/a80043811a9c67d9bc43f11769010df83c4d5264.png"]
New exploration dungeon \[Path of Two Shadows] and related story
From volcano fall onward, the first time you enter the Central Plaza, a conversation will trigger and you'll receive the map
You can then set out on a brand-new two-person exploration in the Forgotten Valley
New romance ending with both Hackett and Benson
New supplementary story for Claude and Carlos
When Claude is the Lord, have more than 9 hearts of Favorability with Claude and obtain the Heaven's Society Badge, then talk to the Principal at the Lord's Quarters to trigger the new story
Added a brand-new opening (OP), new BGM, full Japanese voice acting, and Traditional Chinese text. Existing translations have also been revised and polished.
You can switch between the original and new BGM under "Settings" > "BGM Settings".
Added character voice toggles.
Go to “Settings” → “Character Voice Toggle” to turn individual characters’ voices on or off.
Fixed an issue that could cause the story to get stuck during the Winter Fire Year.
Fixed an issue where clicking during the opening video could cause the game to freeze.
Fixed an issue where tooltips in the fitting room would remain on screen.
The game can now run in the background. Taking screenshots with Steam no longer interrupts voice playback.
Increased movement speed on the map and horse racing speed.

1. Fixed an issue where skipping the childhood Birdie Festival scene partway through jumped straight to Month 2 of volcano summer, missing the opening ceremony and Lord selection in Month 1 and making Gwyneth your Lord by default
2. Fixed an issue where the screen could freeze after the ending dialogue in some romance endings (such as Jeffrey's ending)
3. Fixed an issue where clicking quickly or holding Left Ctrl to speed through dialogue occasionally showed the previous line's text under the current speaker
4. Fixed an issue where the first CG in the Main Story section of the Exhibition could not be collected if the opening scene was skipped. This CG is now unlocked by default
Fixed an issue where birthday cards could be opened even when the card count was 0, leaving the window unable to close. Also improved invalid card filtering and page navigation.

Fixed issues where the save list could appear empty or display information from older saves instead of newer ones. Improved save migration from older versions and backup protection, and added a notification when saving fails.
Fixed an issue where conversations could sometimes display only dialogue choices, without character information such as portraits and affection levels.
Fixed an issue where conversations with certain characters could sometimes skip the greeting and jump straight to dialogue choices.
Fixed an issue where some characters’ situational dialogue did not match the current conditions.
Fixed an issue where some characters’ situational dialogue was cut off in English and Japanese.
Fixed an issue on the ending results screen where the categories and amounts for the highest income and spending were incorrectly matched.
Fixed several text display errors.
1. Improved the save system for faster saving, loading, and turn transitions
2. Optimized memory allocation and text data storage to reduce memory usage
3. Optimized the frame rate cap logic, fixing stuttering on some high-end PCs
4. Reduced unnecessary performance overhead in map movement, bulk buying/selling, dice betting, and more, for less stuttering
5. Background music now fades out the old track before fading in the new one, for smoother transitions
6. Improved the stability of dialogue data processing
1. Fixed a crash caused by data errors
2. Fixed incorrect UI positioning at certain resolutions
3. Fixed an issue where choosing to paint and then choosing to leave still counted as an Easel use
4. Fixed incorrect text being displayed in some cases
5. Fixed unnecessary memory usage when skipping text
6. Fixed combat system errors under specific conditions
7. Fixed an issue where new background music was occasionally stopped unexpectedly after switching tracks
8. Fixed an issue where background music played at a lower volume than the set value when replayed after stopping
9. Fixed Horse Racing and character walking speed slowing down at low frame rates
10. Fixed an issue where corrupted save files from older versions were repeatedly converted every time the game launched
11. Fixed various other known issues
If you run into any bugs after updating, please let us know through any of the following channels. We'll work on fixes as quickly as possible. Thank you so much for your support!
Email the bug details to: eggHatcherFeedback@outlook.com

(Regarding save issues, we will try our best to assist you. If you do not receive a prompt response, please send email again to remind us. Thank you very much for your patience and understanding!)

Hello everyone, Steam Cloud is back online!
This update increases the number of save slots to 24, improves the save file structure, then enhancing the stability of the cloud save feature.

After updating to version 2.02, when you first launch the new version of the game, old version save files will automatically be moved to the "OldVersionArchives" folder in the save directory for backup. It is also recommended that you manually back up your save files before launching the new version of the game.

notes.title: How to retrieve your save files

items.text: Press Win+R on your keyboard and type AppData.
Go to \LocalLow\EggHatcher\VolcanoPrincess.
*If you have previously played on multiple devices using the same account, it is recommended to first disable cloud save for backup, and then enable cloud save when launching the game.
*If you wish to play an older version, move the old save files back to the original "VolcanoPrincess" folder.

Previously, since save files were stored in AppData/LocalLow, players who hadn’t logged in for a long time might have triggered Windows 10/11's automatic cleanup function. We sincerely apologize for this!
If you encounter any issues with save file updates or while playing after Steam Cloud has been enabled, we kindly ask that you submit a bug report to help us improve. Thank you very much!

【Test Version for Save File Optimization】
We are working on optimizing the save file structure of Volcano Princess to provide greater stability for restarting Steam Cloud saves.

The new version of the save file is still under testing, with the number of save slots increased to 24. If you would like to experience the new version early, you can play through the Steam Beta branch using the test code: archiveTest2409.

Note: When launching the beta version for the first time, old version save files will be automatically moved to the "OldVersionArchives" folder in the same directory. To play the old version, you will need to move all old save files back to the parent directory "VolcanoPrincess."

items.text: Dear parents,
Children's Day is coming soon! Happy Children's Day in advance to all of our players!

notes.title: A. Major Update - New Romance Endings, and Lebsa Event modification

items.text: Volcano Princess will have its first major update on May 31.

notes.title: Besides the fixes and balances, the main changes are

items.text: 1- A new revision and interpretation of the Lebsa Event.

The developers attach great importance to player's feedbacks. They heard the voices that the Lebsa Event took place too fast and sharp to accept, so they decided to modify the narrative of the event. Besides, they are adding more explainations and details in the plot to make the story happen more smoothly.
More than 10 drawings are added for this modification.
2 - Three New Multi-NPC Romance Endings

notes.title: The three new romance endings are

items.text: A. Ze & Hackett & Daughter
B. Lon & Craig & Daughter
C. Gwyneth & Mona & Daughter
Japanese will be installed in mid to late June. We will inform the exact date in advance so please stay tuned with us!
Thank you support! If you meet any bugs, please submit a Gle Form. And welcome to the official Discord!
